The design

A · Two folded shells: tray + U-cover

Round 2: 46 x 5 knob caps. Two hand-folded 1.0 mm aluminium sheets. The tray (base, front wall with screen and knob, rear wall with USB-C, RCA and jack) carries everything; the U-cover (top and both sides) drops over it and takes 4 screws into clinch nuts in the tray's tabs. USB and Ethernet face the left side; the side knob and a Wi-Fi slot are on the right side; the microSD is reached with the cover off. Processor heat goes through a pad under the Pi into the base.

Mechanism
Pi + DAC stack slides rearward on the base until the RCA barrels pass the rear wall, then 4 screws from below; cover drops on, 4 side screws
Layout
Pi flat, USB-C long side at the rear, USB/Ethernet edge flush with the left side, SD end at the right; screen and front encoder in the 12 mm zone behind the front wall
Load path
knobs -> walls -> base -> feet -> shelf
Process
laser-cut flat, 6 + 2 hand folds on perforated lines (UNTESTED recipe)

Flat pattern: Tray (base + front + rear)

6 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0. Untested folds: no coupon has held for this recipe yet.

Flat pattern: Cover (top + sides)

2 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0. Untested folds: no coupon has held for this recipe yet.
